office_does: District Court judges hear misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil suits up to $100,000, small claims, protection orders and felony first appearances for Clark County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Chad E. Sleight is the only candidate for Department 2.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since March 2017 (appointed by the County Council, re-elected 2018 and 2022) and a former city prosecutor; the only candidate.
highlights: Appointed to the bench by the Clark County Council in 2017; re-elected 2018 and 2022 [S1]
Prosecutor for Battle Ground, Ridgefield and La Center 2009-2017; pro tem judge 2013-2017 [S1]
